docs:
Balance Card — A counting balance, a liquid currency selector and a drawer that settles.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Inter Tight. If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans and look noticeably different.
